items.title: 2026 NFL Trade Deadline live updates: Tracker, deals, news, rumors, analysis
items.text: Jeffery Simmons, DeForest Buckner, Quenton Nelson and more big-name NFL players are on the move.

items.title: Jim Harbaugh: I want Khalil Mack to be here and Khalil Mack wants to be here
items.text: Jim Harbaugh shot down a question about the Chargers potentially trading defensive lineman Khalil Mack before next week's deadline.

items.title: Jeffery Simmons: Felt great to get my first sack as a Chicago Bear
items.text: "The emotions, especially during the national anthem, the emotions were coming and coming," Simmons said.

items.title: Ravens K Tyler Loop could be headed for injured reserve with groin injury
items.text: When it comes to injuries, the Ravens have far bigger issues than having a healthy kicker.

items.title: Monday Night Football: Jeffery Simmons, Caleb Williams lead Bears to 34-17 rout of Seahawks
items.text: The Bears acquired Simmons on Thursday, and he had six tackles and a sack, and Williams threw for 247 yards.

items.title: Bears answer Seahawks, up lead to 27-17
items.text: The Bears have had an answer for the Seahawks all night.

items.title: Seahawks convert Bears' fumble, now trail only 20-17
items.text: The Bears let the Seahawks back in the game when tight end Colston Loveland fumbled.

items.title: Jacoby Brissett becomes an obvious trade candidate
items.text: By sending eight-game starting quarterback Jacoby Brissett all the way to No. 3 on the depth chart, the Cardinals have sent a clear message to the rest of the league, eight days from the trade deadline.

items.title: D'Andre Swift's TD run gives Bears a 20-9 lead on Seahawks
items.text: The Bears have taken control in Chicago.

items.title: Most Cowboys players left facility on Monday before locker-room media availability
items.text: The day after an embarrassing home loss to the Cardinals — who have never lost at AT&T Stadium — many of the Cowboys' players skipped a session with the media covering the team.

items.title: Monday Night Football: Bears lead Seahawks 13-9 at halftime
items.text: Jaxon Smith-Njigba caught a 43-yard touchdown with 30 seconds left in the half to draw Seattle closer.

items.title: Sean McVay won't say much about the "soreness" in Matthew Stafford's throwing arm
items.text: Rams quarterback Matthew Stafford threw only 25 passes on Sunday.

items.title: Nick Sirianni: Eagles will stick with Tanner McKee, Sean Mannion despite offensive woes
items.text: The Eagles have lost six in a row and rank 30th in the NFL in points per game, but Nick Sirianni said Monday that he isn't making a change at offensive coordinator or quarterback.

items.title: Bears' 17-play drive on their opening possession gives them a 7-0 lead
items.text: The Bears had an almost perfect drive to open Monday Night Football.

items.title: QB Joe Fagnano estimated as limited in Ravens' practice with ankle injury
items.text: The Ravens know Lamar Jackson (right thumb) and Tyler Huntley (toe) won't play Thursday night.

items.title: Jaguars estimate DE Travon Walker as a non-participant Monday
items.text: Jaguars defensive tackle DaVon Hamilton (torn quad) and safety Eric Murray (elbow) are out for the season.

items.title: Chargers TE David Njoku is expected to return to practice this week
items.text: Chargers tight end David Njoku likely will return to practice this week, coach Jim Harbaugh said Monday.

items.title: Monday Night Football: Zach Charbonnet, Jadarian Price are active for Seahawks vs. Bears
items.text: The Seahawks will officially have running backs Zach Charbonnet and Jadarian Price for Monday Night Football.

items.title: Cowboys DBs Caleb Downs, P.J. Locke in concussion protocol
items.text: The Cowboys had injury to go with the insult of Sunday's 33-30 meltdown overtime loss to the Cardinals.

items.title: Ravens QB Joe Fagnano "fighting through a couple things," has "a chance" to play Thursday
items.text: The Ravens are short on healthy quarterbacks with Thursday's game against the Jaguars on the horizon.

items.title: Todd Monken expects to see sacks start to "pile up" for Jared Verse
items.text: Browns defensive end Jared Verse made a fair amount of noise heading into Sunday's game against the Steelers, but he was mostly silent on the field in Pittsburgh.

items.title: John Harbaugh admits calling Amy Adams Strunk about Jeffery Simmons trade
items.text: Giants coach John Harbaugh apparently ruffled some feathers in Nashville by making a phone call to Titans owner Amy Adams Strunk in an effort to spark trade discussions for defensive tackle Jeffery Simmons.

items.title: Report: Kendrick Bourne has a fractured tibia, will miss the rest of the season
items.text: Cardinals head coach Mike LaFleur said at his Monday press conference that wide receiver Kendrick Bourne could miss the rest of the season with a leg injury he suffered in Sunday's overtime win over the Cowboys and a report on Monday evening says that will be the case.

items.title: Packers to sign QB Cam Miller to practice squad
items.text: The Packers are signing free agent quarterback Cam Miller to the practice squad, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN reports.

items.title: Lions lost linebacker Jimmy Rolder to season-ending hamstring injury vs. Vikings
items.text: Lions linebacker Jimmy Rolder will miss the rest of the season after suffering a hamstring injury on Sunday against the Vikings.

items.title: Patriots waive S Elliott Davison
items.text: The Patriots waived safety Elliott Davison, the team announced Monday.

items.title: Myles Garrett will practice this week
items.text: The Rams will make a decision on his Week 9 status later in the week.

items.title: The NFL, Caleb Williams shoe dispute takes center stage on Monday night

items.title: Stephen Jones: We think we're close, still open to adding in a trade
items.text: Blowing a 14-point lead in the fourth quarter of an overtime loss to the Cardinals didn't do much to inspire confidence in the Cowboys from the general public, but it doesn't appear to have led to much of a change in the internal thinking about the team.

items.title: Cardinals WR Kendrick Bourne's ankle injury could end his season
items.text: Cardinals wide receiver Kendrick Bourne had a non-contact injury with 21 seconds left in the first half of the team's 33-30 overtime win over the Cowboys.
